ideas.pitch: An individual offline-first practice environment optimized for 30-minute 60-question quantitative aptitude sprints.

ideas.title: QuantFast Speed-Prep Engine

ideas.pitch: An individual analytics dashboard to parse historical quantitative test patterns, track pacing bottlenecks, and optimize decision-making under strict time limits.
